summary: Frontend-only validation of 3 new tip-feed / Hall-of-Fame features (renamed HOF earn button, clickable usernames -> gift wallet, HOF slip lightbox). All three flows verified end-to-end against preview URL with real admin login; no console errors observed.
verified_flows: HOF earn button renders new label 'Show what you won with TipJar' (win.showWin key) via data-testid='hof-earn-btn' and opens Win Claim modal.
Hall of Fame has 1 winning slip; image-open button data-testid='hof-open-0' opens full-screen lightbox with data-testid='hof-viewer', hof-viewer-img, hof-viewer-close, hof-viewer-user rendered.
HOF viewer close button and outside-click both dismiss the overlay.

HOF viewer owner label shows '@TipJarAdmin' at bottom-left; clicking it while logged in as the same user correctly no-ops (self-gift prevented by openGiftTo guard, matches requirement 'gifting requires login' and username !== user.username).
Rate Wall (view-tips-btn) shows 8 tip cards each with a data-testid='gift-user-btn-<tipId>' clickable username button.
Logged-OUT click on a tip-card username opens the auth/login modal (auth-modal visible, wallet-modal not shown).

Logged-IN (admin) click on a DIFFERENT member's username (TipJarHQ) opens WalletModal (data-testid='wallet-modal') on the Gift tab (data-testid='gift-panel') with recipient input (data-testid='gift-to') pre-filled with 'TipJarHQ'.
i18n keys win.showWin and wall.giftUser exist for all 8+ locales in /app/frontend/src/i18n.js (en, es, de, el, fr, it, ar, tr, ...).
critical_code_review_comments: HallOfFame lightbox: bottom-left owner button is nested inside the image container that stops propagation (e.stopPropagation on the inner div). Good — outside-click still bubbles through the outer overlay. Verified.
WalletModal.useEffect sets tab and giftTo on every open; when reopened without a giftTarget the tab correctly falls back to 'buy'. Good.

In App.js openGiftTo, when username === user.username the function silently returns; consider a small toast like 'You cannot gift yourself' for better UX (currently the HOF viewer click on your own slip appears to do nothing).

One transient React warning was observed once during the first exploratory run: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component'. Could not reproduce on subsequent runs; likely benign but worth watching. If it recurs, check that setGiftTarget/setWalletOpen in openGiftTo are not called during a parent's render (they are inside a useCallback triggered by a click handler, so should be safe).
test_credentials: TipJarAdmin / TipJarAdmin2026! (login via [data-testid=login-btn] then auth-username + auth-password + auth-submit)
seed_data_creation: None. Existing seed data (1 won slip in HOF; 8 AI-picks tips with distinct usernames) was sufficient.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features (HOF earn label, clickable usernames -> gift, HOF lightbox) are functionally correct. The lone slip in HOF is owned by TipJarAdmin, so to observe the viewer-user click actually opening the wallet you must be logged in as a DIFFERENT user than TipJarAdmin (or add another won slip). For Rate Wall, use view-tips-btn -> any AI/Members tip card. Logged-out state uses [data-testid=auth-modal]; logged-in uses [data-testid=wallet-modal] with gift-panel + gift-to prefilled.
